contacts.notes: Met at HIMSS 2026. Very interested in reducing documentation burden across their 850-provider network. Current pain point: Epic Slicer Dicer shows 2.4 hrs/day avg documentation time. Piloting with 10 providers in Q3. Exec sponsor is Dr. Rajesh Mehta (CMO).

CMO and key executive sponsor for the Midwest Health Partners deal. Quoted in a JAMA article on physician burnout. Very vocal about reducing clinician attrition — lost 18 physicians last year citing administrative burden. Strong internal champion.

Referred by Dr. Chen (CT05) who is already a DeepScribe customer. Sandra manages all 12 providers at Pinnacle. Very process-driven — wants detailed ROI analysis and integration specs before moving forward. Pilot discussion underway.

Submitted demo request form after downloading the Burnout Report. 8-provider cardiology clinic on Cerner. Concerned about Cerner integration compatibility — needs technical validation call. Wants to start with a 30-day pilot.

Solo primary care physician. Has been a customer since Dec 2025. Reports saving 1.5 hours/day on documentation. Has referred 3 colleagues to DeepScribe. Candidate for case study and testimonial. Renewal due Dec 2025.

Outbound sequence response. Hospital is mid-sized (320 beds, 180 providers). Currently using Nuance DAX but dissatisfied with accuracy and support responsiveness. Strong competitive displacement opportunity. Evaluation committee includes CMO, IT Director, and 2 hospitalists.

Technical decision-maker at Bluegrass Regional. Focused on HIPAA compliance, Epic FHIR API integration, and SSO/Active Directory requirements. Requested security white paper and BAA template. Works closely with James Hartley.

Manages a 22-provider primary care group. Signed 12-month contract in Oct 2025 for 15 providers. Contract renewal and expansion to full 22 providers coming up in October 2026. High satisfaction — NPS score 9. Expansion deal in progress.

Requested a demo via website after attending a webinar. ClearView is a large MSO managing 50+ providers across multiple specialties. CMO is the sponsor; wants enterprise-wide solution. eClinicalWorks integration is a potential blocker — need to confirm roadmap support.
Downloaded ROI Calculator for Group Practices. 9-provider orthopedic group. No contact yet — assigned to outbound sequence. Epic shop.

Came in through LinkedIn ad campaign. Telehealth company with 40 virtual-only providers. Unique use case — ambient scribe for video visits. Responded to initial outreach but hasn't committed to a demo yet. Follow-up sequence active.

Solo family medicine physician, referred by Dr. Chen. Customer since Feb 2026. Uses DeepScribe daily. Very satisfied — active in the DeepScribe user community Slack channel. Annual renewal due Feb 2027.

Internal physician champion at Pinnacle Oncology. Participated in the product demo and was very enthusiastic about the oncology-specific note templates. Agreed to be the pilot lead for the 12-provider trial.

Brought into the Midwest deal by Dr. Park. Owns the Epic infrastructure. Completed security review in August. Focused on Epic App Orchard listing validation and data residency requirements. Legal review on MSA is now the primary gating item.

CIO at ClearView MSO, looped in by Dr. Marsh. Focused on IT security, integration lift, and ongoing support SLAs. Key concern is eClinicalWorks compatibility and the level of professional services required for deployment.

deals.deal_name: Midwest Health Partners — Enterprise AI Scribe
deals.notes: 850-provider deployment. Pilot completed with 10 providers — 78% reduction in documentation time reported. Pilot NPS: 9.2. Legal review of MSA underway; primary sticking points are data residency (must remain US), BAA indemnification language, and audit log retention period. Target close Nov 2026.

Competitive displacement from Nuance DAX. Hospital is unhappy with Nuance accuracy on hospitalist notes and response times for support issues. Proposal sent for 180-provider license. Awaiting budget approval from CFO. Strong champion in VP Clinical Ops.

deals.deal_name: Pinnacle Oncology — 12 Provider Pilot to Close
deals.notes: 12-provider oncology-focused pilot underway since Sept 1. Using DeepScribe oncology note templates (Oncology SOAP, Staging Summary, Chemo Plan notes). Dr. Osei (CT13) is the internal champion. Formal review meeting scheduled Oct 3. ROI doc shared.

Demo completed Sept 18, well received by CMO and CIO. eClinicalWorks integration is a question — engineering confirmed it's supported via FHIR R4 with middleware. Next step: technical deep-dive call with Priya's (CIO) IT team and a security questionnaire response.

Discovery call scheduled for Sept 30. Need to validate Cerner integration use case and confirm note types they need (Cardiology H&P, Cath Lab notes, stress test documentation). Budget holder is Medical Director (CT04). Practice Manager handles procurement.

deals.deal_name: Valley Primary Care Group — Expansion (15 to 22 Providers)
deals.notes: Expansion from existing 15-provider contract (annual value $108K) to full 22-provider group. Contract sent for e-signature. Expansion driven by word-of-mouth within the practice. Angela (Practice Manager) is aligned; just needs sign-off from Managing Partner. Very high probability.

deals.deal_name: Dr. Sarah Chen — Individual License Renewal
deals.notes: Original deal. Solo primary care physician in San Francisco. Closed in 5 days from demo request to contract. Annual subscription, auto-renew enabled. Strong advocate and referral source.
Physician referral from Dr. Chen. Closed in 8 days. Family medicine solo practice in Portland. Auto-renew enabled. Renewal due Feb 2027.

deals.deal_name: Valley Primary Care Group — Initial Contract (15 Providers)
deals.notes: Initial 15-provider contract for Valley Primary Care. Athenahealth integration setup included. Closed in 22 days. Strong champion in Practice Manager Angela Torres.

Lost to Nuance DAX. 9-provider neurology group. DAX won on the basis of Microsoft Enterprise Agreement pricing and existing Teams/Azure integration. Primary contact was VP Operations. Loss review completed: competitive pricing and bundled MSFT licensing were the deciding factors. Created competitive battle card for Nuance DAX as a result.
New lead from ROI Calculator download. Enrolled in outbound sequence. No contact yet. Orthopedic-specific note templates (Ortho H&P, Operative Note, Post-Op Note) would be a strong value driver.

Unique telehealth use case — ambient scribe for video visits. DeepScribe supports Zoom/Teams audio integration. Linda Schwartz (VP Clinical Ops) is warm but hasn't booked a demo yet. In high-intent sequence. Strong potential if we can demonstrate video visit accuracy.

sequences.name: Physician Burnout Outreach — Individual & Small Practice
sequences.description: A 6-step, 3-week sequence targeting individual physicians and small practice owners (1-5 providers). Highly personalized tone — leads with physician burnout empathy, shares peer testimonials (Dr. Chen case study), and offers a 15-min no-pressure demo. Best-performing sequence by open rate. Step 4 (case study email) has highest click-through.

sequences.name: CMIO & Health System Enterprise Nurture
sequences.description: A 9-step, 6-week sequence targeting CMIOs, CMOs, and VP Clinical Operations at hospitals and health systems (100+ providers). Content is ROI-heavy and references health system-specific research. Includes Epic App Orchard reference, KLAS report mention, and invitation to a live executive briefing. Slower burn due to longer sales cycles.

sequences.name: HIMSS 2026 Conference Follow-up
sequences.description: Post-HIMSS 2026 follow-up sequence activated March 18, 2026 for all contacts collected at the DeepScribe booth and sessions. 5-step sequence over 2 weeks. High engagement due to warm context of recent in-person meeting. Now paused as all contacts have been fully worked. Will be re-activated for HIMSS 2027.

sequences.name: Pilot to Paid Conversion
sequences.description: A short 4-step sequence for contacts who have completed or are mid-pilot. Focuses on documenting ROI achieved during pilot, surfacing testimonials from pilot users, and creating urgency for conversion to paid contract. Highest reply rate of all sequences. Step 2 (personalized ROI summary email) drives the most conversions.

sequences.name: Competitive Displacement — Nuance DAX
sequences.description: Targets practices and hospitals known to be using or evaluating Nuance DAX (Microsoft Dragon Ambient eXperience). Content is empathetic — acknowledges DAX is well-known but leads with head-to-head accuracy comparison, support quality differentiators, and non-Microsoft pricing flexibility. Includes a 'DAX vs. DeepScribe' side-by-side PDF.
